## Claims
- [source-backed] The project documentation records the stronger statement \(M/\Lambda_+M\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\) only as suspected, and says that a proof had eluded the authors. [source-6, lines 56-72]
- [proved] Let \(q=n-r\), assume \(a=1,b=2\), and use the accepted integral Schur/Pieri presentation \(Q=J_v/A_+J_v\). Then \(i,j\ge2\), \(q-i,r-j\ge1\), \(\min(i,j)=2\), and \(\min(q-i,r-j)=1\).
- [proved] Put
  \[
  x_0=s_{i^j},\quad x_1=s_{(i+1,i^{j-1})},\quad
  x_2=s_{((i+1)^2,i^{j-2})},
  \]
  \[
  y_1=s_{(i^j,1)},\quad y_2=s_{(i^j,2)}.
  \]
  In \(Q\), Pieri relations give
  \[
  \bar x_1+\bar y_1=0,\qquad
  \bar u+\bar x_2+\bar z=0,\qquad
  \bar u+\bar z+\bar y_2=0,
  \]
  where \(u=s_{(i+2,i^{j-1})}\) is interpreted as \(0\) if outside the \(q^r\)-box and \(z=s_{(i+1,i^{j-1},1)}\). Hence
  \[
  \bar y_1=-\bar x_1,\qquad \bar y_2=\bar x_2.
  \]
- [proved] Consequently the two \(a=1,b=2\) proposed families
  \[
  F_1=(x_0,x_1,x_2),\qquad F_2=(x_0,y_1,y_2)
  \]
  have images related in \(Q\) by the unimodular diagonal matrix
  \(\operatorname{diag}(1,-1,1)\). Thus either family is an integral basis of its span in \(Q\) exactly when the other is.
- [conjectural] **Uniform \(a=1,b=2\) elimination lemma.** In the accepted integral presentation of \(Q\), all Schur columns other than \(x_0,x_1,x_2\) admit integral unit-pivot elimination, with no residual relation on these three columns. Equivalently,
  \[
  Q\cong\mathbb Z\bar x_0\oplus\mathbb Z\bar x_1\oplus\mathbb Z\bar x_2.
  \]

## Strategy
The displayed relations are respectively the images of
\[
h_1x_0=x_1+y_1,\qquad
h_1x_1=u+x_2+z,\qquad
h_2x_0=u+z+y_2.
\]
They vanish in \(Q\) because \(h_1,h_2\in A_+\); \(h_2\) exists since \(q\ge i+1\ge3\). Subtracting the latter two relations yields \(\bar x_2=\bar y_2\).

The proposed elimination lemma isolates the remaining issue: prove integral elimination of every complementary Schur class and prove that the three surviving classes have neither an integral relation nor torsion.

## Gaps
- Integral independence of \(\bar x_0,\bar x_1,\bar x_2\) is not proved.
- Torsion-freeness of \(Q\) is not proved.
- Thus \(Q\cong\mathbb Z^3\), and minimality of either family, remain unresolved.
- No independent review evidence is supplied in this attempt.

## Next
Prove a degree-compatible unit-pivot elimination for the complementary Schur columns in the \(a=1,b=2\) presentation, then certify the remaining \(3\times3\) quotient block has zero relation lattice integrally.
